hook_line: JAILER 2 CROSSES RS 800 CRORE, A FIRST FOR TAMIL CINEMA

hook_stat.sub: Worldwide gross — the first Tamil film to reach the mark

stats.label: Worldwide gross after day 18, according to Sacnilk
India gross after day 18, per Sacnilk
Overseas gross after day 18, per Sacnilk

diaspora_bullets: Overseas markets supplied about a third of the gross
North America and the Gulf remain central to the record run
news_summary: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has crossed Rs 800 crore in worldwide gross, becoming the first Tamil film to reach the mark, TrackTollywood reported on Sunday.
payoff: TrackTollywood framed the next target as Rs 850 crore.
